findings.evidence: `Hom.lean:64-65` defines `toOverHom` as a functor map; `CommGrp.forget` is `forget₂Grp C ⋙ Grp.forget C` (mathlib `CategoryTheory/Monoidal/CommGrp_.lean:133`) and `forget₂Grp` is `inducedFunctor CommGrp.toGrp` (ibid. `:82`). `IsMonHom.one_hom (f)` has type `η ≫ f = η` (mathlib `CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Mon.lean:212-214`), so `IsMonHom.one_hom f.hom.hom.hom.hom` matches the line-94 goal only up to unfolding those induced functors.
findings.fix: Add one documented bridging lemma, e.g. `lemma Hom.toOverHom_def (f : A ⟶ B) : Hom.toOverHom f = f.hom.hom.hom.hom := rfl` with a comment on why it is `rfl`, and prove the four sites by `rw [Hom.toOverHom_def]` (or `simp [Hom.toOverHom_def]`) before applying the Mathlib lemma. That localizes the wrapper defeq to a single place, matching the pattern already used for `Hom.toOverHom_mk'`.
findings.issue: `Hom.one_hom` (95), `Hom.mul_hom` (102), `Hom.inv_hom` (108) and `Hom.ext` (150) state goals in terms of `Hom.toOverHom f`, defined at line 65 as `(inducedFunctor _ ⋙ CommGrp.forget _).map f`, but are discharged by terms about `f.hom.hom.hom.hom` (`IsMonHom.one_hom`/`mul_hom`, `GrpObj.inv_hom`, `Over.OverMorphism.ext`). They typecheck only by unfolding the `AbelianVariety`/`CommGrp` induced-category wrappers and `Mon.Hom`, with no lemma or comment recording that equality — the same undocumented defeq the comment at lines 85-86 says clients should not depend on.

summary: The identity/composition/mk' projection lemmas are now proved cleanly via functor laws and a documented `change`, but four remaining proofs still close goals stated with `Hom.toOverHom` using terms about the raw `f.hom.hom.hom.hom` projection, relying on undocumented definitional equality through two induced-category wrappers.
